What Is Archon Astrology?

Most astrology tells you who you are. Archon Astrology tells you what is attempting to define you. It is a modern mythic system grounded in gnostic exploration and deep-shadow work.

Each celestial body is governed by an Archon—a symbolic "warden" of consciousness. By identifying your Archon, you identify the specific narrative parasite that feeds on your potential. This is not about prediction; it is about preservation of the soul's sovereign will.
